recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless Pharmacy later chooses to add separate best-practice guidance about populating planned dosage on not-done administrations.
issue_request: FHIR-27834 asked that MedicationAdministration.status = not-done be valid when no dosage information is available; the Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution clarified that MedicationAdministration.dosage is 0..1 and that mad-1 should require dosage.text, dosage.dose, or dosage.rate[x] only if dosage is present.
initial_application: Commit aa9bb900cb46fbcac2b5689dcf3a735a3524f12c updated the old MedicationAdministration spreadsheet mad-1 row from dose/rate-only wording to the present-dosage text/dose/rate requirement. The later source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that invariant into source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition keeps MedicationAdministration.dosage optional and attaches mad-1 to the dosage backbone, so the expression applies only when dosage exists. Pharmacy 2020-06-29 minutes corroborate the Jira constraint clarification, and a later Zulip implementer thread did not establish a conflicting requirement to make dosage mandatory for not-done administrations.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already allows absent dosage for not-done MedicationAdministration instances and constrains populated dosage to include text, dose, or rate[x].
